2. 3. runsheet/src/services/portalApi.ts: typed functions for every design §3 route via fetchWithSession + apiErrorFromResponse like commerceApi.ts; blob downloads like exportApi.ts; Idempotency-Key header for payment create; Retry-After surfaced on 429; no WebSocket. runsheet/src/types/stripe-js.d.ts minimal declarations (Stripe(pk), elements({clientSecret}), create('payment'), mount, confirmPayment).

4. PD23 formatting with Intl; 320 px reflow; targets >= 24x24 px; existing Tailwind tokens.

5. Reloaded the latest version.'

6. CSP: runsheet/src/config/securityHeaders.ts adds script-src https://js.stripe.com, frame-src https://js.stripe.com https://hooks.stripe.com https://*.stripe.com, connect-src https://api.stripe.com https://*.stripe.com; stays Report-Only (the base already has /api/csp-report from OI-10; keep it).

7. Existing staff Jest suites pass unchanged.

Playwright (F5, not in CI): runsheet/e2e/portal/*.spec.ts with axe (zero serious/critical) on every portal page, keyboard-only sign-in -> new request -> invoice PDF download, and 320 px reflow (scrollWidth <= clientWidth); driven by PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL and QA portal credentials from env; skip cleanly when those env vars are absent. DEVIATIONS / CHOICES (minor)
- D-F6-1 app/portal/layout.tsx is a server layout that exports metadata.title and renders the client PortalGate, instead of being a client layout itself: a client layout can't export metadata, and the step requires a title on every segment. Behavior matches §10.2.
- D-F6-2 The portal orders page has no customer Cancel button: §10.2 lists the page as 'list + Request delivery link' only. cancelPortalOrder exists in portalApi for a later UI decision. RESOLVED in integration iteration 2 (review R2, owner decision 2026-10-08): app/portal/orders/page.tsx has a 'Cancel request' button on cancellable rows (aria-label 'Cancel request <order_id>', aria-disabled while in flight, no confirm step); success or 409 ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE refreshes the list in place, announces through a polite LiveRegion and refocuses the row; other errors use the role=alert banner.
- D-F6-3 Overview 'Open balance' sums remaining_cents over the first page (limit 50) of open/partial/overdue invoices and prefixes 'At least' when any status has another page. No new API was added.
- D-F6-4 Customer-facing texts the spec does not fix were chosen plainly (portal disabled / suspended / load errors, 'Request sent', ACH clearing note, stale reading text, 'About N days until empty'). The fixed texts (PD10, PD15, R6.13 labels, 429, 'Forecast not available yet', 'This request changed. Reloaded the latest version.') are verbatim.
- D-F6-5 A `creating` payment replay polls GET /payment-attempts every Retry-After seconds (2) until `created`, then makes the one include_client_secret=true read; a 502 or a terminal replay discards the stored key; IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT stores a fresh key and asks the user to Continue again.
- D-F6-6 Decline has no confirmation dialog (design §10.3 specifies plain Confirm/Decline buttons).
